<a id="huoli"></a>
## `huoli`

调用方式: `huoli --help`

```text
Usage: huoli [--profile] <name> [options] [app-args...]
       huoli plugin --profile <name> <pnpm-args...>

huoli: boot a Huoli Core profile — an ordered stack of plugin-bundle patch
layers under your own overrides.

Arguments:
  args                           arguments for the booted profile's app (see:
                                 huoli --profile <name> --help)

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --profile <name>               the profile under $HUOLI_HOME/profiles to boot
  --from-default-profile <name>  replace a custom profile with a fresh copy of a
                                 shipped profile template
  --patch <path>                 extra patch-list overlay applied after the
                                 profile layer (repeatable)
  --dump-config                  print the composed profile tree and exit
  --dump-config-schema           print JSON Schema for profile entries and
                                 patches without mounting
  --dump-default-config          print the profile tree without its user layer
                                 or --patch overlays and exit

Examples:
  huoli headless "run the tests"              answer one task, print the result, and exit
  huoli rescue --from-default-profile headless
                                            recreate rescue from the shipped headless template, then boot it
  huoli tui --patch ./extra.yml               boot a custom profile with one extra overlay
  huoli tui --resume <session>                arguments after the launcher flags reach the app
  huoli plugin --profile tui add <package>    install a plugin into the tui profile

```

<a id="huoli-plugin"></a>
## `huoli plugin`

调用方式: `huoli plugin --help`

```text
Usage: huoli plugin [options] [args...]

manage a profile's plugins by forwarding the remaining arguments to pnpm in the
profile directory

Arguments:
  args              pnpm arguments, forwarded verbatim (add <pkg>, remove <pkg>,
                    why <pkg>, ...)

Options:
  --profile <name>  the profile whose plugins to manage (initialized on first
                    use)
  -h, --help        show this help
```

<a id="huoli-acp"></a>
## `huoli acp`

调用方式: `huoli acp --help`, `huoli --profile acp --help`

```text
Usage: huoli --profile acp [options]

Serve automation clients over Agent Client Protocol stdio.

Options:
  -h, --help  show this help

Example:
  huoli --profile acp     serve ACP until the client disconnects

```

<a id="huoli-headless"></a>
## `huoli headless`

调用方式: `huoli headless --help`, `huoli --profile headless --help`

```text
Usage: huoli --profile headless [options] [task...]

Answer one task and exit; the answer goes to stdout and diagnostics to stderr.

Arguments:
  task                        the task text; multiple words are joined by
                              spaces, and `-` reads stdin

Options:
  --json                      write newline-delimited run events to stdout
                              instead of the final message
  --session-id <id>           adopt the persisted Session with this id; an
                              unknown id is an error
  --permission-mode <preset>  select a configured permission preset for this
                              task, including on resume
  --approval-policy <policy>  set approval behavior after selecting the
                              permission preset (choices: "ask", "never")
  --add-dir <path>            allow an additional physical absolute directory
                              under workspace-write (repeatable)
  -h, --help                  show this help

Examples:
  huoli --profile headless "run the tests"          answer one task and exit
  echo "run the tests" | huoli --profile headless   read the task from stdin
  huoli --profile headless --json "run the tests"   emit machine-readable run events
  huoli --profile headless --session-id session-… "continue"   resume an existing Session
  huoli --profile headless --permission-mode workspace-write --add-dir /repo/.git "commit the fix"
                                                        grant shared Git metadata for this task

```

<a id="huoli-sdk"></a>
## `huoli sdk`

调用方式: `huoli sdk --help`, `huoli --profile sdk --help`

```text
Usage: huoli --profile sdk [options]

Serve Huoli Core SDK clients over stdio JSON-RPC.

Options:
  -h, --help  show this help

Example:
  huoli --profile sdk     serve one SDK runtime until its client disconnects

```
